name.description: The agent name the provision command carries as its name suffix. The installer sets it from the command name.

command.description: The agent provision command's flat data, verbatim. The installer sets it from the command.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for the agent PVCs. Empty uses the cluster default StorageClass.

instructions.description: Object-storage delivery of instruction content. The harness init container syncs each agent's folder <bucket>/system:serviceaccount:<namespace>:ag-<agent>/ from this endpoint, reading with the pod's own projected service-account token; the serving container mounts the result read-only and holds no token for the store.

endpoint.description: Cross-namespace Service address (host:port) of the shared cluster object store the sync init container reaches. The harness egress netpol reads the store namespace from this host.

bucket.description: Bucket holding every agent's instruction tree.
